title: Prior-dependent neural timing representations
scientific_question: Over verified common sampled-interval support, do short and long prior contexts differ in a prespecified retrospective Set–Go neural-trajectory contrast after response-modality/direction and temporal-block controls, and what within-session uncertainty supports that conclusion?
primary_outputs: An independently recomputed matched-prior difference in measured response-conditioned neural trajectories on complete prespecified interval/modality/direction/block support, with its support and within-session uncertainty. Null, reversed and unsupported contrasts are valid; the empirical value is not supplied by the paper narrative. Authentic raw Set–Go observations are prepared for the declared204-row/54-unit scope; the scientific trajectory basis, matched-support estimand, independent reference and uncertainty remain unqualified.
